title: City of Spearfish - Snow Removal Subscription Service
description: Applications for the Snow Removal Subscription Service are now available. Stop by City Hall or call Public Works at 605-642-1333 to learn more about the program and get an application.

title: City of Spearfish - Weather & Roads
description: Staff are monitoring weather and road conditions. If warranted, snow removal crews will be dispatched as early as 4:00 AM Wednesday. Operations will focus on Priority 1 and Priority 2 routes to ensure main travel corridors are cleared.

title: City of Spearfish - Winter Weather - Friday April 3rd
description: Winter weather is expected on Friday. Plow operators will be dispatched as needed in the morning & throughout the day.  Crews will focus on Priority 1 & 2 routes and then move to Priority 3 routes if necessary.

title: City of Spearfish - Traffic Signal Outage - 27th St & Colo Blvd
description: The traffic signal at 27th St & Colo Blvd will be out for several hours on Wednesday April 8th starting at 9am.  The intersection will function as a 4-way stop until power is restored.  Please use caution in the area.

title: City of Spearfish - Memorial Day Closure & Trash Collection
description: City Hall, Library and Restricted Use Site will be closed on Monday, May 25th for Memorial Day. Monday trash customers will be picked up on Tuesday.

title: City of Spearfish - Weather Siren Test
description: The Police Dept will be conducting a Spring Weather Siren Test on Thursday, May 28th at 2:00PM. This is to test the functionality of our sirens as we approach our sever weather season.

title: City of Spearfish - Weather Siren Test at 2pm
description: The Police Dept will be conducting a Spring Weather Siren Test today at 2:00PM. This is to test the functionality of our sirens as we approach our sever weather season.

title: City of Spearfish - Monday June 8 - Water Repair at North Ave & Michigan
description: Repair work will take place in the middle of the intersection starting at approx 8:00AM. Traffic will be shifted to the outside lanes of North Ave while work is in progress. Expect delays & use caution when traveling through the area.

title: City of Spearfish - North Ave & Michigan Traffic Control
description: Traffic control at North Ave & Michigan will remain in place for the rest of today and throughout tomorrow to allow paving operations to be completed in the area where water line repairs were recently made.

title: City of Spearfish - Juneteenth Closure
description: City Hall Offices, Library, & Restricted Use Site will be closed on Friday June 19, 2026. There will be no changes to garbage collection.

title: City of Spearfish - Independence Day Closure
description:
City Hall Offices, Library, & Restricted Use Site will be closed Fri. July 3rd and Sat. July 4th.  Garbage collection will be moved to Mon July 6th. 
Have a safe and happy holiday weekend!

title: City of Spearfish - Emergency water repair/low pressure in Harmony Heights
description: An emergency repair is being performed in the vicinity of 1200 block of Jackson Blvd. Residents in Harmony Heights will have water, but will experience low pressure until repairs are completed.

title: City of Spearfish - New sign installations at Spearfish Mountain View and West Elementary Schools
description: New street signs are being installed to improve school zone safety around West Elementary and Mountain View Elementary Schools.

title: City of Spearfish Labor Day Closures
description: City Hall Offices, Library, & Restricted Use Site will be closed on Monday, September 7, 2025.  Trash collection will be moved to Tuesday.

title: City of Spearfish - City Hall, Library & Rec Center Closure
description: City offices, Library & Spearfish Rec Center will be closed from 8am-2pm on Wed, Sept 23rd for an all-staff training. There are no changes to the trash collection schedule & the Restricted Use Site will remain open during its normal operation hours.

title: City of Spearfish - Downtown Street Closure
description: Temporary Main Street closure from Jackson Blvd to Grant St beginning on September 28, 2026.
